title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1991-09-20
source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:034799) SBD > DAT > CDR > WAV > SHNv3 and Audience (shnid:101438) Set 1 - Schoeps CMC34 (ORTF) > Oade Supply > Panasonic sv255; Set 2 - B&K 4011 110 degrees ORTF > Neumann BS 48i-2> Modified Sony TCD D-10 Pro 16 bit - 48kHz DAT Master > TASCAM DA-20 (SPDIF out) -> LynxTWO-B Audio Reference Interface (SPDIF in) -> Wavelab 6.0

ai_review.summary: Great‑sounding matrix recording featuring a beautifully played Brokedown Palace and a gorgeous Bird Song in the first set
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises this matrix source as “great sounding,” noting clear, balanced audio that captures the band well. Musically the first set shines with a wonderfully rendered later‑era Brokedown Palace and an especially beautiful Bird Song, leaving listeners eager for the second set.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review, but its enthusiastic language rates both performance and recording highly; limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a ‘great sounding’ matrix mix – clear, well‑balanced, no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Positive comments focus on the first set; reviewer highlights strong playing and expresses excitement for a second set.
